questions.prompt: How does availability differ from anchoring?
questions.answer: Availability concerns ease of recalling instances; anchoring concerns influence from an initial reference value.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Separates both mechanisms and uses appropriate independent evidence.
scoring.transfer: Create a two-column audit of one numerical estimate and one frequency judgement. Record the initial cue, an independent comparator and an updated judgement.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
